name: oido-google-calendar
description: List, create, search, and read Google Calendar events via OAuth2 using MCP server.

settings.name: CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: OAuth2 client ID from Google Cloud Console

settings.name: CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: OAuth2 client secret from Google Cloud Console

settings.name: CALENDAR_REFRESH_TOKEN
settings.description: OAuth2 refresh token for long-lived access to Calendar API

settings.name: CALENDAR_ID
settings.description: Calendar ID to use (default: 'primary' for main calendar)

settings.name: CALENDAR_MAX_RESULTS
settings.description: Maximum number of events to return per list/search (default: 20)

settings.name: CALENDAR_TIMEZONE
settings.description: Timezone for event display (e.g. America/New_York, default: system timezone)
